title: 420Hz Generate Community Awards threat model
protectedAssets: Wallet/session actor authority and replay domains
private generation prompts, lyrics, reference audio, draft mixes, stems and project history
provider credentials, model/provider identity and execution/result commitments
generation provenance, AI disclosure, consent and source-right references
canonical Creative Work/Recording/Creator identity and publication state
420 Rights claims/licenses/provenance and derivative/voice consent boundaries
payer authorization, funded job credit, accepted price, provider entitlement and payer refund state
community follow/favorite/playlist source records and privacy
qualified playback/listener evidence and ChartSnapshot determinism
moderation reports, evidence, decisions, appeals and challenge history
storage integrity hashes, tombstones, deletion state and retention policy
Search/Indexer/Analytics/Notifications derived projections and freshness markers
service configuration, secrets, logs and operational credentials
trustBoundaries: 420Hz -> Creative Protocol / 420 Rights registration and publication
adversaries: authenticated Wallet actor with no privileged capability
malicious/Sybil Wallet operator controlling many accounts
malicious generation user crafting prompt/tool/provider injection payloads
malicious external evidence source or stale Arbitration observer

threatCatalogue.name: Prompt/tool injection
threatCatalogue.risk: prompt or metadata attempts to override provider/tool policy, exfiltrate secrets or widen execution authority
mitigations: treat prompt/lyrics/reference metadata as untrusted content
provider adapters use fixed structured job schema and bounded capability
no prompt may alter Wallet/payment/rights/moderation authority
secrets are never injected into model-visible payloads unless explicitly required and scoped
tool/network access is denied by default unless a later provider profile explicitly qualifies it
threatCatalogue.residual: provider/model content-safety quality remains non-deterministic; authority is bounded regardless

threatCatalogue.name: Provider/result spoofing
threatCatalogue.risk: wrong provider/model/job/result is accepted or paid
mitigations: verify canonical assignment and accepted verification profile
threatCatalogue.residual: model quality itself is not proven by provider identity

threatCatalogue.name: Malicious media/metadata
threatCatalogue.risk: parser exploitation, active content, unsafe container/codec, metadata injection
mitigations: metadata rendered as text, never trusted HTML
media processing sandbox/resource bounds later runtime
threatCatalogue.residual: live codec/scanner hardening remains implementation/testnet work

threatCatalogue.name: Unsafe URL/HTML schemes
threatCatalogue.risk: javascript/data/file/credentialed URL, XSS or SSRF-style abuse
mitigations: allowlist safe schemes/origins at presentation boundary
reject credential-bearing URLs and javascript/data/file schemes where not explicitly allowed
server-side fetch paths use DNS/egress/SSRF defenses
threatCatalogue.residual: final production CSP/egress policy is later deployment work

threatCatalogue.name: Unauthorized reference audio
threatCatalogue.risk: user submits audio without required rights/permission
mitigations: reference input requires explicit authorization path
bind source Work/Recording/License where derivative source is known
private upload alone never implies permission
threatCatalogue.residual: external legal truth may require dispute process

threatCatalogue.name: Unconsented voice/persona
threatCatalogue.risk: impersonation/deepfake or personality-right violation
mitigations: voice/persona claims require explicit consent/authorization metadata
reported dispute may hide publication without rewriting Rights
threatCatalogue.residual: identity/consent verification quality depends on later qualified implementation

threatCatalogue.name: Derivative-rights bypass
threatCatalogue.risk: generated derivative is published despite missing transformation/license authority
mitigations: transformation permission remains separate from training permission
source IDs/licenses are checked before derivative registration/publication
threatCatalogue.residual: competing legal claims may require Arbitration/external adjudication

threatCatalogue.name: Private draft/prompt leakage
threatCatalogue.risk: private prompts, lyrics, drafts, stems or references become public or searchable
mitigations: public provenance commits hashes/metadata, not private prompt bytes
threatCatalogue.residual: production storage/operator controls require later live evidence

threatCatalogue.name: Secrets/provider-token leakage
threatCatalogue.risk: API tokens, private keys, mnemonics or deployment secrets leak
mitigations: provider tokens remain server-side secret refs
secret-like fields excluded from public manifests/logs
threatCatalogue.residual: live secret manager/key rotation is production evidence

threatCatalogue.name: Generation spam/resource exhaustion
threatCatalogue.risk: cost, worker, queue, storage or API exhaustion
threatCatalogue.residual: distributed edge/load controls require testnet/production qualification

threatCatalogue.name: Wallet/session replay or domain substitution
threatCatalogue.risk: captured authorization reused for different actor/chain/action/payload
mitigations: browser button state is not authority
threatCatalogue.residual: runtime signer implementation must preserve these fields

threatCatalogue.name: Payment/accounting confusion
threatCatalogue.risk: quote/funding/accepted price/earning/refund are conflated, double charged or misdirected
mitigations: refund paid requires canonical movement evidence
threatCatalogue.residual: live Vault/Pay integration is later implementation/testnet work

threatCatalogue.name: Storage hash mismatch/resurrection
threatCatalogue.risk: wrong bytes served or deleted state returns from cache/backup
threatCatalogue.residual: provider proof/recovery operations require live qualification

threatCatalogue.name: Stale/reorged derived state
threatCatalogue.risk: stale projection drives privileged/public decision
mitigations: stale state labeled or fails closed
threatCatalogue.residual: live reorg/rebuild evidence deferred to testnet

threatCatalogue.name: Community replay/privacy bypass
threatCatalogue.risk: duplicate relation/count inflation or private state leaks
mitigations: projection rebuild cannot create source state
threatCatalogue.residual: runtime API/rate controls later

threatCatalogue.name: Chart manipulation
threatCatalogue.risk: bot/replay/self/sponsored/manual rank inflation
threatCatalogue.residual: runtime qualified-play threshold and anti-bot signals later

threatCatalogue.name: Collusive nominations
threatCatalogue.risk: coordinated nominators manufacture ballot placement beyond policy
mitigations: community-threshold uses eligible public deduped state
threatCatalogue.residual: social collusion cannot be eliminated purely by architecture; policy must declare assumptions

threatCatalogue.name: Vote stuffing/Sybil voting
threatCatalogue.risk: one actor obtains many votes or replays ballot submissions
mitigations: Identity-unique mode uses privacy-preserving ballot-scoped nullifier
one accepted vote per voter key
threatCatalogue.residual: production unique-human verifier/provider remains later work

threatCatalogue.name: Awards tally/result tampering
threatCatalogue.risk: operator edits totals, winner or finalized history
threatCatalogue.residual: runtime implementation must preserve deterministic input ordering

threatCatalogue.name: Moderation/report bypass or abuse
threatCatalogue.risk: unauthorized censorship, spam, bypass or privilege escalation
mitigations: block/mute do not create protocol authority
threatCatalogue.residual: live moderator staffing/response policy is operational

threatCatalogue.name: Evidence/privacy leakage
threatCatalogue.risk: private evidence or Identity proof is published from a commitment/reference
threatCatalogue.residual: evidence host/key management later operations

threatCatalogue.name: Arbitration authority escalation
threatCatalogue.risk: ruling treated as superuser command
mitigations: Arbitration cannot directly move funds/rewrite Rights/Awards
threatCatalogue.residual: no 420Hz Arbitration domain/runtime is claimed yet

threatCatalogue.name: Provider/operator compromise
threatCatalogue.risk: compromised service attempts authority substitution or data tampering
threatCatalogue.residual: key rotation/suspension/incident runbooks deferred to production

threatCatalogue.name: Cross-component confused deputy
threatCatalogue.risk: one service's valid claim is reused as authorization in another domain
mitigations: no Community->AwardVote or Chart->AwardResult implicit conversion
threatCatalogue.residual: later API/interface contracts must preserve domain typing

acceptedDesignRisks: AI model output quality/safety is probabilistic and provider-dependent; authority/rights/payment decisions remain deterministic outside model prose
Wallet-one-account-one-vote does not provide unique-human guarantees
social collusion cannot be fully eliminated by static policy and must be bounded/observable
off-chain evidence availability is not guaranteed by an on-chain/content commitment
qualified anti-bot, media scanner, edge-rate-limit and provider isolation controls require runtime/testnet evidence
external legal rights/personality disputes may remain unresolved until canonical/external adjudication
failClosedRules: missing/ambiguous actor, chain, domain, capability or replay context blocks mutation
missing reference/voice/derivative authorization blocks restricted generation/publication path
private/unlisted data never degrades into public visibility on dependency failure
stale/unverified derived state cannot authorize privileged or irreversible action
unscoped moderator/Arbitration action blocks remedy consumption
required service identity/version unavailable or wrong-network blocks dependent action rather than falling back to guessed authority
invariants: HZGCA-THREAT-INV-001 no prompt, model output or provider metadata can grant Wallet, Rights, payment, moderation or governance authority
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-002 private prompts/drafts/reference audio never enter public Search/Indexer/Analytics by fallback
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-003 provider identity/signature alone never proves accepted result correctness or settlement entitlement
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-004 generation reference/voice/derivative paths fail closed without required authorization/consent
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-005 retries/replays never duplicate charge, provider entitlement, community relation, chart credit, nomination candidate or vote
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-006 unsafe media/metadata/URL input never becomes executable application authority
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-007 storage integrity mismatch or deletion tombstone cannot be overridden by cache/backup/projection state
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-008 derived services never become canonical when stale, compromised or unavailable
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-009 Charts remain deterministic/rebuildable and cannot accept hidden sponsored/manual rank mutation
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-010 Awards finalization remains frozen-policy, replay-safe, deterministic and single-use
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-011 unique-human claims require qualified privacy-preserving eligibility and are never inferred from Wallet count
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-012 moderation is scoped application enforcement and cannot rewrite external protocol truth
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-013 private evidence commitments never grant public disclosure authority
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-014 Arbitration rulings are bounded inputs and never ambient cross-domain execution authority
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-015 operator/provider credential compromise has bounded authority and cannot become unrelated protocol/custody authority
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-016 stale/reorged projections fail closed for security-sensitive actions until canonical reconciliation
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-017 every security-sensitive cross-boundary input binds sufficient source/domain/version/replay context
HZGCA-THREAT-INV-018 HZ-GCA-1.15 creates no new runtime service, contract, custody, resolver, Identity, Rights, payment or governance authority
deferredRuntimeEvidence: distributed edge rate limiting and abuse controls
live secret manager and credential rotation
exitCriteria: protected assets, trust boundaries and adversary classes are explicit
all canonical HZ-GCA-1.15 threats are represented with mitigation/residual risk
fail-closed rules and security invariants are explicit
accepted versus deferred runtime risks are separated
targeted verifier proves threat inventory, prerequisite binding and no-authority guarantees
no live security control, deployed service, ABI, address or testnet evidence is invented
